checks.Simpson_paradox: Reported domains separately; N10 directions agree. H10 differs by domain/comparator.
checks.ecological_fallacy: Paired user-level ranks; no claim every user benefits.
checks.Berkson_selection: Repeated development pool selected for exploration; generalization remains unconfirmed.
checks.collider_bias: Primary comparisons use all fixed 512 users; hit-overlap groups are descriptive, outcome-defined.
checks.base_rate_neglect: Report absolute N10/H10 and hit counts alongside relative changes.
checks.regression_to_mean: Same-user matched controls; selection after previous exploration remains a limitation.
checks.survivorship_bias: All expected users in all four completed jobs retained; no successful-row-only filtering.
checks.look_elsewhere: All domains and planned controls reported; intervals unadjusted, no confirmatory significance claim.
checks.forking_paths: Expert shortlist selected using prior results; current protocol fixed before new generation.
checks.causal_language: Conditional component comparison with refitted common fusion; not a general causal claim about user behavior.
checks.reverse_causality: No target supplied as inference input; only held-out development targets used in outcome calculations.

decision: SASRec + text is a provisional exploration configuration; necessity is not established robustly.
